title: Account — rasa.module.crm (records-family/1)
description: A customer or company: the hub. One file, crm/accounts/acct-<slug>.md, whose stem IS the id; the display name is the H1. 'Current customers' are the accounts in the active status. An account's contacts are derived from the cards that name it; its leads from the leads that name it. Accounts are never archived: `status` carries churn.

id.description: acct-<slug>: the one slug-keyed record in the family, and the business-ops @acct-<slug> join key. The file is exactly crm/accounts/<id>.md (C-02). Never renamed, never reused.

updated.description: Bumped by every tool edit; `crm touch` after a hand edit.

status.description: Where the account stands: one of config `account_statuses` (default prospect, active, churned) (C-11). Changed only by `crm account status` or `crm lead win`.

since.description: The day the account entered its current status; never in the future (C-16).

tier.description: The account's segment. Declare to constrain: config `tiers`.

owner.description: Who is accountable for the relationship.

label.description: work, home, mobile, … Declare to constrain: config `labels`.

pref.description: Only ever `true`, on at most one item of the list (C-07); an item that is not preferred omits the key.

email.description: The account's own addresses (billing@, info@). At most one pref (C-07).
